newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BA's Ayling mum after meeting EU's Van Miert.
newsitem.headline: BA's Ayling mum after meeting EU's Van Miert.

text.p: British Airways chief executive Robert Ayling refused to comment on Tuesday on the substance of a meeting with European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert.
"The contents of what we discussed were confidential between the two of us," Ayling told reporters as he left the meeting.

He would not answer directly whether his presence indicated a recognition of the Commission's role in vetting his company's planned alliance with AMR Corp's American Airlines, a role he and the British government have contested.

"There are many matters of common interest that I have to discuss with Mr Van Miert and his colleagues. The European Commission has an important part to play in the development of European aviation policy," he said.
Van Miert trod a similar line when questioned by reporters shortly after, say nothing on the meeting's substance.
